# add cassia back into seurat object
```{r}
## doesnt work- email cassia
seurat_obj <- add_cassia_to_seurat(
  seurat_obj = seurat.obj,
  cassia_results_path = "/w5home/bmoore/scRNAseq/LiFangChu/10x_somite_data/output_20260916_181955/pTLS_D4_Mgel_F20CH7/CASSIA_Pipeline_somite_pig_20260921_135814/03_csv_files/pigTLS_D4_Mgel_F20CH7_FINAL_RESULTS.csv",
  cluster_col = "seurat_clusters",
  cassia_cluster_col = "Cluster ID",
  prefix = "Cassia_0.5_res_"
)
print(colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data))
```
```{r}
# read in anotation
#results_table <- "/w5home/bmoore/scRNAseq/LiFangChu/10x_somite_data/output_20260916_181955/pTLS_D4_Mgel_F20CH7/CASSIA_Pipeline_somite_pig_20260921_135814/03_csv_files/pigTLS_D4_Mgel_F20CH7_sorted_summary.csv"
results_table <- "/w5home/bmoore/scRNAseq/LiFangChu/10x_somite_data/output_20260916_181955/pTLS_D4_Mgel_F20CH5/manual_annotation_res0.75.csv"
# NOTE: _summary.csv (unsorted) is malformed - its "Predicted General Cell Type"
# free-text field contains unquoted internal commas, so read.csv either errors
# ("more columns than column names") or silently mis-parses/shifts columns.
# _sorted_summary.csv has the same data properly quoted - use that instead.
results_df <- read.csv(results_table, header = TRUE)
head(results_df)
colnames(results_df) # confirm the exact name of the cluster ID column below (read.csv turns "Cluster ID" into "Cluster.ID")

# make sure that idents are the clusters you want annotated
# NOTE: do NOT coerce seurat_clusters with as.numeric() - for a factor that
# returns the internal level code (its position in levels()), not the cluster
# label, and levels() is not guaranteed to be in numeric order (e.g.
# "0","1","10","11","2",... if it was ever coerced through character).
# RenameIdents does not need clusters to be numeric - it matches by name.
seurat_obj <- SetIdent(seurat_obj, value = "merged_clusters")

# Rename the clusters based on the new IDs.
# RenameIdents matches by NAME, not by position, so build cluster.ids by
# pairing each predicted cell type with its actual cluster ID from results_df
# rather than relying on levels(seurat_obj) to be in row order.
cluster.ids <- as.character(results_df$Celltype) #Predicted.General.Cell.Type
names(cluster.ids) <- as.character(results_df$ClusterID)

# diagnostic: confirm the two label sets actually match before renaming
print(levels(seurat_obj))
print(names(cluster.ids))

# sanity check: every current cluster level should have a match; should be character(0)
setdiff(levels(seurat_obj), names(cluster.ids))

seurat_obj <- RenameIdents(seurat_obj, cluster.ids)
# put in resolution-specific annotation metadata column
seurat_obj[["Cassia_gen_group_1"]] <- Idents(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj[["manual_celltype"]] <- Idents(seurat_obj)
# Generate and plot the UMAP plot
pdf(paste0("labeled-clusters_Cassia_gen_group_1.pdf"), bg = "white")
print(DimPlot(seurat_obj,
  reduction = "umap", label = FALSE,
  pt.size = 0.5, group.by = "Cassia_gen_group_1"
) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7), legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")))
dev.off()

pdf(paste0("labeled-clusters_manual_celltype.pdf"), bg = "white")
print(DimPlot(seurat_obj,
  reduction = "umap", label = FALSE,
  pt.size = 0.5, group.by = "manual_celltype"
) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7), legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")))
dev.off()
```

# get markers from both logFC and expression
```{r}
high_expr_dir <- "/w5home/bmoore/Pierre_sc_zebrafish/output_subset-recluster_20260204_094842/Top50_HighExpr_Genes_all_res0.75/"
high_files <- list.files(path = high_expr_dir, pattern = "Top50_HighExpr_Genes_all_Cluster_\\d+\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize list to store genes
cluster_genes_list <- list()

# Loop through High Expression files
for (file in high_files) {
  filename <- basename(file)
  # Extract number from "Cluster_X"
  num <- str_extract(filename, "(?<=Cluster_)\\d+")
  cluster_name <- paste0(num)

  data <- read.table(file, header = TRUE)
  genes <- data$Gene[1:25]

  cluster_genes_list[[cluster_name]] <- genes
}

DE_dir <- "/w5home/bmoore/Pierre_sc_zebrafish/output_subset-recluster_20260204_094842/Top100_DE_Genes_all_res0.75/"
de_files <- list.files(path = DE_dir, pattern = "Top100DEgenes_clust_\\d+\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Loop through DE files and append
for (file in de_files) {
  filename <- basename(file)
  # Extract number from "clust_X"
  num <- str_extract(filename, "(?<=clust_)\\d+")
  cluster_name <- paste0(num)

  data <- read.table(file, header = TRUE)
  # DE genes are row names in this file format
  genes <- rownames(data)

  if (cluster_name %in% names(cluster_genes_list)) {
    # Append and ensure uniqueness
    cluster_genes_list[[cluster_name]] <- unique(c(cluster_genes_list[[cluster_name]], genes))
  } else {
    cluster_genes_list[[cluster_name]] <- genes
  }
}

# Convert to data frame
# Convert zebrafish genes to human genes
for (name in names(cluster_genes_list)) {
  genes <- cluster_genes_list[[name]]
  # Map to human genes
  human_genes <- gene_symbols_df$Human.gene.name[match(toupper(genes), gene_symbols_df$Zebrafish.Gene.name)]
  # Remove NAs and empty strings
  human_genes <- human_genes[!is.na(human_genes) & human_genes != ""]

  cluster_genes_list[[name]] <- unique(human_genes)
}

# Convert to data frame
new_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = names(cluster_genes_list),
  marker_genes = sapply(cluster_genes_list, paste, collapse = ", "),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.csv(new_df, file = "markers2_all_celltypes_0.75.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
